description: This file contains CSS styles for a frontend application, defining themes and styles for various components including dark and light themes, as well as animations and responsive design for mobile devices.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class that centers content and applies primary background color and text color from defined CSS variables.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header component of the application that displays in the center with adjustable background color.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Link component which changes color based on the current theme.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button component for toggling themes, with hover and active styles applied.
